Haryana, Rajasthan Sign Water-Sharing Pact After 32 Years

Haryana and Rajasthan have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to operationalize a 1994 agreement on sharing Upper Yamuna river waters. The pact, which aims to streamline water management between the two states, was signed in New Delhi and presided over by Union Home Minister Amit Shah. The agreement also reportedly greenlights a Rs 34,102 crore water project.
